title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Agnes Scott College
description: Late-night dining options for Agnes Scott students range from on-campus grill favorites to the 24-hour staples of downtown Decatur.

cards.title: Mollie's Grill
cards.subtitle: Alston Campus Center
cards.notes: Visit the lower level of Alston for grilled sandwiches and snacks. It is the primary on-campus spot for late-night bites using student meal plan declining balance dollars.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus late-night dining hub at Agnes Scott College.
cards.evidence_claim: Mollie's Grill is located in the lower level of the Alston Campus Center and serves grilled favorites and convenience items.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic semesters; check current campus dining schedules for specific late-night closing times.

cards.title: Waffle House on McDonough
cards.subtitle: 515 N McDonough St
cards.notes: Walk to this 24-hour staple just north of campus for classic breakfast fare. It is a frequent destination for students seeking a booth and hashbrowns at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast institution located within walking distance of the college.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House at 515 N. McDonough Street in Decatur is open 24 hours a day.

cards.title: Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams
cards.subtitle: Decatur Square
cards.notes: Head to the square for artisan scoops until midnight on weekends. It is a popular spot for a post-study dessert run in the heart of downtown Decatur.
cards.short_summary: A popular ice cream shop on Decatur Square with late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jeni's Decatur Square is open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and until Midnight Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Cook Out
cards.subtitle: Lawrenceville Hwy
cards.notes: Drive to this regional favorite for late-night trays and milkshakes. Known for staying open until 3:00 AM or later, it serves as a primary late-night drive-thru option.
cards.short_summary: A classic Southern late-night drive-thru known for its variety of milkshakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations typically stay open until 3:30 AM or 4:30 AM, especially near college campuses.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:30 AM Sunday-Thursday and 4:30 AM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Besto (formerly Victory)
cards.subtitle: 340 Church St
cards.notes: Visit this rebranded American-Italian spot for sandwiches and late-night service. It maintains the casual, student-friendly atmosphere of its predecessor in downtown Decatur.
cards.short_summary: A casual American-Italian restaurant in downtown Decatur offering late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Victory Sandwich Bar rebranded to Besto in July 2026, continuing to offer casual dining at 340 Church St.
cards.source_title: Victory Sandwich Bar rebranding to Besto in Decatur
cards.access_notes: Check current hours for late-night service; historically open until midnight or later.

cards.title: The Iberian Pig
cards.subtitle: 121 Sycamore St
cards.notes: Enjoy Spanish tapas on the square until 11:00 PM on weekends. It offers a more upscale late-evening dining experience for students and visitors in Decatur.
cards.short_summary: A Spanish tapas restaurant on Decatur Square with late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Iberian Pig in Decatur is open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Butter & Cream
cards.subtitle: 416 Church St
cards.notes: Stop by for small-batch ice cream until 11:00 PM daily. This local favorite is known for its handcrafted flavors and proximity to the Decatur Square.
cards.short_summary: A local handcrafted ice cream shop with consistent late-evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Butter & Cream in Decatur is open until 11:00 PM every day.

cards.title: Raging Burrito & Taco
cards.subtitle: 141 Sycamore St
cards.notes: Grab a burrito on the patio until 10:00 PM on Fridays. A long-standing Decatur favorite, it provides a casual atmosphere for late-evening meals near the square.
cards.short_summary: A casual Mexican restaurant on Decatur Square with late-evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Raging Burrito is open until 10:00 PM on Fridays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Fridays; other nights close at 9:00 PM or 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Black Cat Coffee
cards.subtitle: Alston Campus Center
cards.notes: Get your caffeine fix on campus at this student-run cafe. It serves Starbucks coffee and light snacks, often staying open late during peak study periods.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus coffee shop at Agnes Scott College.
cards.evidence_claim: Black Cat Coffee is located adjacent to Mollie's Grill in the Alston Campus Center and serves coffee and snacks.
cards.access_notes: Check current campus dining schedules for specific late-night closing times.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Downtown Decatur
cards.subtitle: 101 W Ponce de Leon Ave
cards.notes: Visit this downtown location for a quick meal until 10:00 PM. It is a reliable option for students looking for familiar fast food within walking distance of campus.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located fast-food option in downtown Decatur.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chick-fil-A in Downtown Decatur is open until 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.
